rules.main_model_note: Principal model = S1_narrative_full (8 district characteristics + 5 forced controls). VIF>10 retained and reported.

note: Outcome: deaths from diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs and certain disorders involving the immune mechanism (ICD-10 D50-D89), 2011-2025. District characteristics: suspected anaemia (standardised ratio) and suspected kidney disease at national health screening, basic livelihood security recipients, tertiary education, unmet medical need, long-term care hospitals per 100,000 aged 65+, internal-medicine specialists per 100,000 and ill-defined causes of death; five forced controls; negative control exposures hit-and-run collisions, traffic-culture index and fires; comparison outcomes transport-injury deaths and gastric cancer patients. Values not published for 2025 carry their 2024 values.
